properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. From Anthony's VS Code work log (SOURCE: art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05, entry of 2026-10-02, "member capture", reflow2 0.76.0), measured, in its words: "`--call record_finding` with `"confidence":"high"` refused `expected f64`; retried with `0.9`, then refused `Validation error on TemporalFact.basis: invalid enum value '...', expected one of ["measured", "forecast"]`. Two round trips; the finding (an agent-chosen fallback awaiting owner word, neither measured nor forecast) had no fitting `basis` and was left unrecorded. Inferred: `record_finding` has no home for 'observed by reading the code'." The entry of 2026-10-01 met the same refusal with `inferred`.

WHAT IS ALREADY TRUE:
- `basis` is `measured | forecast` (main, 2026-10-05). It means TENSE: something that happened, or something expected. The word is overloaded: four value sets within one hop of a TemporalFact, and the everyday sense "how do you know?" matches `provenance` better (fact:root-cause-basis-names-four-value-sets-around-a-temporal-fact-and-provenance-a-fifth-2026-10-02, which left any rename or alias to the owner).
- reflow2's own design records a static reading as `measured` and says "(static)" in the text, for example fact:some-edge-types-are-several-relations-split-by-a-property-value-so-a-per-type-reading-is-wrong-for-part-of-them-2026-09-28.
- A sibling question is open for checks: dec:idea-a-check-closes-at-a-stated-evidence-grade-under-an-owner-set-rule (measured run, operator-attested, inferred).

TWO THINGS ARE IN THE REPORTER'S CASE, and they may have different answers:
1. An OBSERVATION MADE BY READING code or a document, rather than by running something.
2. AN AGENT'S PROVISIONAL CHOICE awaiting the owner's word. That is intent at `proposed`, which reflow2 records as a Decision, not as a fact.

OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN:
(a) A THIRD `basis` VALUE: `observed`, `read` or `inferred`.
(b) A SEPARATE `method` ON A FINDING (run / read / reported) beside `basis`, so tense and method stop sharing one word.
(c) NOTHING NEW IN THE SCHEMA: record_finding's description says a reading is `measured` with the method stated in the text, and that a provisional choice is a proposed Decision.
(d) RENAME `basis` on TemporalFact to say what it means, with the old name accepted.

SIZE: (a) small: an added enum value widens the schema, so no migration. (b) moderate: a property every reader of findings would have to show. (c) small: description text and the root-cause skill. (d) moderate: vocabulary across the surface and its readers.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, kept beside it:
- Reading code IS an observation of something that exists now, so `measured` covers it. A third value would split one kind of fact by method while the rest of the schema keeps method in the text.
- The reporter's finding was a choice awaiting the owner. Giving it a `basis` would let a choice read as an observation, which rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word guards against.
- One evidence-grade vocabulary for findings and checks may be better than two. Settling this one alone could fix a word the check question then has to match.
properties.name: OPEN — should a finding be able to say it was observed by reading (code, a document), neither measured by a run nor forecast, and where does an agent's provisional choice awaiting the owner's word go?
